_meta.about: CampusBite demo seed data: 45 real Lucknow restaurants grouped into 9 categories. Restaurants can belong to several categories (e.g. a Mughlai place that also sells rolls).
_meta.disclaimer: Demo/educational use only. Not affiliated with any restaurant. Menus and prices are illustrative approximations, not official menus.
_meta.images: loremflickr keyword images (free, no key). Do not use restaurants' logos or photos.
